passages.text: Ittai answered the king, and said, “As Yahweh lives, and as my lord the king lives, surely in what place my lord the king is, whether for death or for life, your servant will be there also.”
passages.note: Loyalty to someone in their hardest hour

passages.text: The king said to Zadok, “Carry God’s ark back into the city. If I find favor in Yahweh’s eyes, he will bring me again, and show me both it, and his habitation; but if he says, ‘I have no delight in you;’ behold, here am I. Let him do to me as seems good to him.”
passages.note: Surrendering an uncertain outcome during a fall from power
